people.name: Thomas Castelli
sources: Thomas Castelli partner biography and podcast role
Tax Smart investor education and community
people.profile: Hall CPA identifies Thomas Castelli as a partner and tax strategist who hosts the Tax Smart REI podcast. Tax Smart Investors describes investor education and community access.
people.offering: Compare investor education and community access with a separately defined Hall CPA advisory and filing engagement.
people.scenario: You own rentals personally and through a partnership and want to review a new acquisition. Ask which entity and owner analyses are included and who implements the final depreciation and filing decisions.
questions: Is the purchase investor education or a Hall CPA engagement?
Who reviews entity and owner-level tax limitations?
Which projections, elections and return tasks are included?
What advisor access and implementation deadlines are contracted?
people.boundary: Confirm the current contracting entity, assigned team and any direct creator involvement in the written engagement.
people.fee: Request a current written quote for the selected service. The reviewed official pages do not establish a universal fixed fee covering planning, implementation and filing.

people.name: Clint Coons
sources: Clint Coons founder role and asset-protection education
people.profile: Anderson Business Advisors identifies Clint Coons as an attorney and founder focused on real estate asset protection and business planning. His site describes investor workshops.
people.offering: Distinguish workshop access, entity implementation and legal work from tax advice and return preparation.
people.scenario: You plan to move rental assets into an entity structure. Compare document drafting, title and lender coordination, ongoing entity obligations and tax-return consequences rather than buying an LLC package from a webinar alone.
questions: Is this a workshop or an individualized legal engagement?
Who drafts documents and coordinates property transfers?
Which tax planning and filing work is included?
What maintenance, registered-agent or membership fees continue?
people.boundary: Confirm the legal scope and actual assigned attorney. AE’s standard tax advisory engagement does not replace legal drafting, asset-protection counsel or entity administration.
people.fee: Request a current written quote for the selected service. The reviewed official pages do not establish a universal fixed fee covering planning, implementation and filing.

people.name: Karla Dennis

people.offering: Confirm program eligibility, advisor access and implementation responsibilities rather than treating a tax-coaching proposal as an all-inclusive filing package.

people.fee: Request a current written quote for the selected service. The reviewed official pages do not establish a universal fixed fee covering planning, implementation and filing.

people.name: Sharon Winsmith
sources: Sharon Winsmith biography and education model
people.profile: Sharon Winsmith’s site describes Winverse wealth education and separately priced consultations. It identifies her background as a tax attorney.
people.offering: The consultation page labels calls educational and informational and states that they do not create an attorney-client relationship or supply legal, tax or investment advice.
people.scenario: You want to discuss a proposed structure before asking your own professionals to implement it. Compare the educational discussion with the separate advisory, legal documentation and return-preparation work you still need.
questions: Is this a membership or a specific consultation?
What records will be reviewed before the session?
What written output or follow-up is included?
Which separate professionals implement and file the resulting work?
people.boundary: Do not equate an educational consultation with an individualized legal or tax advisory engagement. Her consultation terms expressly distinguish them.
people.fee: The consultation page lists a one-hour Zoom session at $1,500, a two-hour session at $2,500 and a full-day onsite session at $10,000. Confirm current inclusions, travel and follow-up; these are different educational consultation scopes, not a universal tax preparation fee.
